This [[skill quest]] is given by [[Ivor Trueshot]] in [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Regent Valley]]. You have to kill 5 [[Plague Worm]]s in 1 minute and 30 seconds.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| profession = ranger
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Follow the ridge east until you find a [[Plague Worm|plague worm]]. Kill all the Plague Worms in the time allotted.
* Kill [5...0]/0 more Plague Worm[s].
* Return to [[Ivor Trueshot]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Ivor Trueshot will give you a [[Starter Bow|Starter bow]] and the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Read the Wind}}
** {{skill icon|Point Blank Shot}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
This is a simple quest. Just go to the pointed location and kill all the worms in under 1 minute and 30 seconds. Using the skills provided with the quest will make it much easier for [[Bow]] wielding characters.

== NPCs ==
=== Foes ===
[[Worm]]s
* {{x}} 1 [[Plague Worm]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ivor Trueshot
:''"There are many aspects to being a Ranger, but none more important than skill with a bow. I can help you become a great archer, but first you must show me that you have potential. If you follow the ridge eastward, you'll find a colony of plague worms anxious to rise up from the ground and attack the unsuspecting traveler. If you can kill all the '''plague worms''' in the allotted time, I'll believe you have the makings of a real Ranger. I'll give you a couple skills, temporarily, that a true marksman would use to meet this challenge."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I like a good challenge.
| decline =  I don't have time for your games.
| ask = Hurry to the east and kill those '''plague worms'''. I won't give you more time just because you're standing around here.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Ivor Trueshot
:''"I can see that you will be a great archer some day. Keep these skills, and as long as you follow the path of marksmanship, they will serve you well."''

==Notes==
*The worms do not need to be killed with a bow to complete this quest.
*The skills will not be removed if the quest is abandoned or the timer runs out. This is useful if a careful experience management strategy is needed.
*Once the quest is completed, the worms will not spawn anymore
